definitions.meaning: Sacrificial, having the nature of a sacrifice or offering

quotations.old_english: Swá oft swá hí offrodon ða láclícan lác ðe ðá gewunelíce wǽron
quotations.english: as often as they offered the sacrificial offerings that were then customary

source_text: lác-líc; adj. Sacrifcial, having the nature of a sacrifice or offering :-- Swá oft swá hí offrodon ða láclícan lác ðe ðá gewunelíce wǽron as often as they offered the sacrificial offerings that were then customary, L. Ælfc. P. 39; Th. ii. 380, 18.
